thread:
maria: Quick ask — ACME POC SIG/CAIQ flagged 'shared tenancy / data at rest' as a blocker. Sales needs a scoped exception for a 30d POC so they can sign. Can we triage?
kevin: AE here — customer wants to start next week. They won't accept dedicated infra for POC. If we can do a documented exception with compensating controls we close the deal.
jordan: SE — we can do a scoped isolation pattern: ephemeral single-tenant pool for the POC + per-customer CMK + S3 SSE-KMS + audit streaming to their SIEM. Token rotation + restricted IAM for all operator accounts.
maria: That sounds reasonable. We need the minimal list of controls we'll require, plus a deployable config snippet and an ops runbook to attach to the exception ticket. Also confirm no PHI/PCI in sample data.
jordan: Proposed controls (short):
- Dedicated logical tenancy for POC (ephemeral dedicated GPU pool)
- Customer-managed CMK (KMS) with key rotation and limited key policy
- S3 SSE-KMS + enforce bucket policy + VPC endpoint
- TLS1.3 enforced, strict cipher list
- Audit log export to customer Splunk/Datadog endpoint (streaming)
- Short-lived credentials / daily rotation for POC tokens
- IAM scoping: redact and limit developer/operator access
- Pen test schedule or existing pentest report attached
maria: Please paste the config snippet we'll run so ops can repro. Also we need a checklist for approvals (CISO, Legal).
jordan: Config snippet: ```
resource "redwood_infra_pool" "acme_poc" {
  tenancy = "dedicated"
  region  = "us-west-2"
  kms_key = "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:alias/acme-poc-cmk"
  audit_export = "https://splunk.acme.com/collector"
  token_rotation = "24h"
}
```
leo: Legal note — we'll need the risk acceptance document signed by the CISO or Director of Security. Also confirm data classification (no PHI/PCI) before we issue exception; if PHI/PCI present, escalate to legal + compliance.
anne: @maria @jordan I can approve a scoped interim exception for 30 days with conditions: (1) implement the controls listed, (2) wire audit exports into our SIEM and enable weekly alerts, (3) update SOC2 scope notes for the POC, (4) create JIRA SEC-9327 with the checklist completed before go-live. After 30d we will review and either revoke or require Dedicated contract.
security-bot: Ticket created — SEC-9327 (created by maria). Checklist autogenerated: [isolation, kms, audit-export, rotate-keys, legal-signoff]. Link: https://jira.redwood/SEC-9327
maria: I'll attach the ops runbook, sample configs, and screenshots into SEC-9327. ETA 48h for deployment and evidence.
kevin: Customer confirmed they accept a 30d scoped exception with those controls. Thanks team :tada: I'll notify them once we attach the runbook.
anne: Approve (CISO anne) — signed off for 30d scoped POC exception.
jordan: Starting deploy now. Will post runbook and deployment logs into SEC-9327 when done.
maria: Marking thread: approved-for-poc. Creating CR to track extension/contract conversion after review period. Closing thread.
